title: MCP Server Registry
description: Registry of MCP servers available to the visual generation agent. Template variables use {name} syntax for path/runtime variables and {env.VAR} for environment variable references.

variables.description: Documentation of available template variables. Keys are variable names, values are human-readable descriptions.

servers.description: Map of server name to server configuration.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this server provides.

type.description: Transport type. Currently only stdio is supported.

args.description: Command arguments. May contain {variable} templates resolved at runtime.

env.description: Environment variables to pass to the server process.

isRequired.description: Whether this variable must be set. Default false.

isSecret.description: Whether this variable contains sensitive data (API keys, tokens). Default false.
